'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 2 Cole Lepine LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cole Lepine]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Username:''' clepine
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
